label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

BANK_ACCOUNT_CURRENCIES.note: Which currencies a TEST account can add.

BANK_ACCOUNT_DETAILS_CURRENCIES.note: TEST currencies listed for account details; each still answers rail.bank, as no banking partner is wired.

BANK_ACCOUNT_TERMS_JSON.note: Made-up base-tier terms labelled TEST so the account panel has something to read; not a price.
BANK_ACCOUNT_TERMS_JSON.value: {"tier": "TEST base tier", "version": "local-test-1", "currency": "USDT", "monthlyFee": "0", "minimumBalance": "0", "overdraftFee": null, "included": ["TEST spaces for your goals", "TEST moves between your spaces"]}

BANK_ADDRESS_BOOK_CAP.note: How many withdrawal addresses one person may save (J-wallet-04).

BANK_OFFRAMP_COOLING_HOURS.note: How long a newly saved withdrawal address waits before money may leave to it (J-wallet-04).

BANK_SPACE_LIMIT.note: TEST number of live named spaces per account, small so a journey can reach the limit.

BANK_WALLET_PROOF_VALID_DAYS.note: How many days a verified wallet ownership proof holds (J-wallet-04).

BANK_WALLET_PROOF_WINDOW_MINUTES.note: How many minutes a wallet ownership proof stays open for signing (J-wallet-04).

IDENTITY_ACCOUNT_TIERS.note: Three TEST account tiers; TEST Premier leaves its monthly fee blank so a tier that cannot be assigned is shown.

IDENTITY_API_KEYS_MAX_BY_TIER.note: Live API keys per account at each verification level, so the developer room can show the fourth key refused.

IDENTITY_REFERRAL_ATTACH_WINDOW_SECONDS.note: Ten minutes after sign-up to attach a referrer through a link, so a new invitee attaches and an older account is refused (J-campaigns-05).

IDENTITY_REFERRAL_CODE_LENGTH.note: Eight characters per short referral code.

IDENTITY_SECURITY_LOCK_UNLOCK_WAIT_SECON.note: A security lock ends one day after its unlock is asked for.

IDENTITY_SUB_ACCOUNT_FEATURES.note: Which trading features a main account may turn on for each sub-account kind. Futures is refused in code until derivatives eligibility is readable.

MINING_OVERVIEW_COIN.note: TEST coin name. Not a product default.

MINING_OVERVIEW_HARDWARE.note: TEST hardware line. Not a product default.

MINING_OVERVIEW_NOT_SUPPORTED.note: TEST unsupported line. Not a product default.

MINING_OVERVIEW_REVENUE_SPLIT.value: TEST in proportion to accepted work
MINING_OVERVIEW_REVENUE_SPLIT.note: TEST revenue-split sentence. Not a product default.

MINING_OVERVIEW_VERSION.note: TEST version stamp for the pool overview. Not a product default.

MINING_OVERVIEW_WHAT.note: TEST sentence for what the pool is. Not a product default.

MINING_POOL_HOST.note: TEST pool host a miner copies. Not a product default.

MINING_POOL_PORT.note: TEST pool port a miner copies. Not a product default.

MINING_POOL_SECURE_URL.note: TEST secure URL, published only in this profile.

MINING_PROBE_LIMIT.note: TEST reachability presses one account may make in the window.

MINING_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS.note: TEST how long one reachability press waits. Not a product default.

MINING_PROBE_WINDOW_MS.note: TEST reachability window. Not a product default.

MINING_WORKER_NAME_PATTERN.note: TEST worker-name pattern. Not a product default.

NOTIFY_INBOX_PAGE_SIZE.note: Inbox page size, so the notification centre lists (J-home-ia-05).

OPS_RESTORE_ARCHIVE_URL.note: TEST joint-restore archive URL. Nothing is behind it and the archive is not probed, so no backup is listed; it only lets restore steps run on the test stack.

OPS_RESTORE_TARGET.note: TEST label for the restore storage target. It names no real storage; it only lets restore start and finalize run on the test stack.

QUANT_ACCOUNT_MARGIN_CALL_PERCENT.note: TEST margin call when equity falls to the margin used.

QUANT_ACCOUNT_MAX_LEVERAGE.note: TEST simulated-account maximum leverage for margin backtests.

QUANT_ACCOUNT_STOP_OUT_PERCENT.note: TEST stop-out close under the margin call, so a short TEST tape shows both events in order.

QUANT_CHECK_MAX_OFFSET_SHIFT_PERCENT.note: TEST sensitivity threshold: warn when starting one bar later moves the return by over 1 percentage point.

QUANT_CHECK_MAX_SAMPLE_GAP_PERCENT.note: TEST overfitting threshold: warn when the out-of-sample return falls over 5 percentage points below in sample.

QUANT_CHECK_MAX_VARIANTS.note: TEST overfitting threshold: warn from the fourth variant, so a journey that tries five sees the warning.

QUANT_HOLDOUT_START.note: TEST holdout: the latest 15 minutes of the TEST tape, so a journey can run clear of it and be refused inside it.

QUANT_OOS_MAX_DRAWDOWN_PERCENT.note: TEST largest out-of-sample fall from a peak, in percent. QUANT_OOS_MAX_SHORTFALL_PERCENT is left blank on purpose so the screen shows a verdict that names a missing criterion.

QUANT_OOS_MIN_RETURN_PERCENT.note: TEST: the out-of-sample part must not lose money after costs.

QUANT_OOS_MIN_TRADES.note: Out-of-sample round trips a TEST backtest needs before it is judged; one, so a short TEST tape can be judged.

SUPPORT_ATTACHMENT_STORE.note: Keeps attached files in the process memory, lost on restart. Not durable storage.

SUPPORT_BULK_CAP.note: Batch size for a bulk change of support requests, so a journey can use the bulk bar. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_MALWARE_SCANNER.note: Blocks only the EICAR test string and calls every other file clean. Finds no real malware.

TAX_DEPOSIT_BASIS.note: A deposit, reward or transfer in has no cost until the customer enters one; its value on arrival is still shown.

TOKEN_PROPOSAL_LIMIT.note: TEST cap of 20 proposals per author per 7 days. Blank in production refuses token.proposal_limit_unset.

TOKEN_PROPOSER_RULE.note: TEST who may open a proposal: at least 1000 of the staking asset. Blank in production refuses token.proposer_rule_unset.

TRADE_CANCEL_ALL_AFTER_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS.note: One second sweep so journeys finish fast.

TRADE_COLLATERAL_HAIRCUT_BPS.note: Cash in the settle asset counts in full, so futures opens are held only by their margin.

TRADE_FEE_SCHEDULE.note: Zero fee schedule, spot and perpetual, so the order paths post no fee. Without the perpetual block futures orders refuse.

TRADE_MARKET_SLIPPAGE_CAP_BPS.note: Worst price a market buy may be funded at above the best ask.
